subject: Juneteenth Flag Raising Address
overview: Aaron Olapade delivered an address for the Medford Juneteenth flag raising, calling on the community to recommit to equity, protection for all residents, and local justice.

items.title: Juneteenth Address
items.summary: Aaron Olapade delivered an address emphasizing the historical significance of Juneteenth and calling on Medford residents to actively pursue community equity and justice.
